releases.title: Release notes
releases.desc: Version history fetched live from GitHub. Showing the latest 15 releases.

header.label: Open-source PDF editor
header.title: Open PDF Studio
header.desc: Professional-grade PDF annotation, markup, and editing without subscriptions, telemetry, or bloatware. Built with Tauri 2 and SolidJS.

annotations.title: 20+ annotation tools
annotations.desc: Highlight, underline, strikethrough, shapes (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, cloud, arrow), freehand pen, text boxes, callouts, sticky notes, stamps, and image insertion.

measurement.title: Measurement tools
measurement.desc: Distance, area, and perimeter measurement with scale calibration (mm, cm, inches, points). Object snapping to endpoints, midpoints, centers, and edges.

signatures.title: Signatures and stamps
signatures.desc: Draw multi-stroke signatures and save up to 5 for quick reuse. 10 built-in stamps including Approved, Rejected, Draft, Confidential, and Final.

pages.title: Page management
pages.desc: Insert, delete, extract, replace, and reorder pages via drag-and-drop thumbnails. Merge multiple PDFs. Rotate pages 90/180/270 degrees.

redaction.title: Redaction
redaction.desc: Mark areas and apply to permanently remove sensitive content from documents.

forms.title: Forms support
forms.desc: Fill interactive PDF forms (AcroForms and XFA). Create text fields, checkboxes, and radio buttons with JavaScript validation.

watermarks.title: Watermarks and headers/footers
watermarks.desc: Text and image watermarks with opacity, rotation, and position control. Headers and footers with page number, date, time, and filename variables.

export.title: Export and print
export.desc: Export pages as PNG or JPEG at 72-600 DPI. Full print dialog with live preview, page range, scaling, and print-as-image option. XFDF annotation export/import.

multitab.title: Multi-tab and sessions
multitab.desc: Work with multiple PDFs in tabs. Save and restore named workspace snapshots. Recent files with pin/unpin.

languages.title: 39 languages
languages.desc: Full interface translation including RTL support for Arabic, Hebrew, Farsi, and Urdu. 5 themes: Dark, Light, Blue, High Contrast, and System.

tauri.title: Tauri 2
tauri.desc: Rust backend for native performance and small binary size.

solid.title: SolidJS
solid.desc: Reactive UI framework with fine-grained updates.

pdfjs.title: PDF.js + pdf-lib
pdfjs.desc: Mozilla PDF.js for rendering, pdf-lib for document manipulation.
